title: Container fails on CPU without x86-64-v3
rootCause: The ActiveGate container image moved to a RHEL UBI 10 micro base (Sprint 345), which requires x86-64-v3.
resolution: Verify the host CPU supports x86-64-v3. If the hardware cannot be upgraded, pin the previous ActiveGate version.

title: No systemd or SystemV init script found
pattern: Neither systemd nor SystemV initialization script found
rootCause: Init script or service registration is missing or corrupted (seen on RHEL 9.8).
resolution: Recheck the dynatracegateway.service unit. A manual reinstall may be required.

title: runuser denied plus SELinux AVC denials after patching
pattern: runuser: may not be used by non-root users|avc:\s+denied
rootCause: SELinux policy corrupted or misaligned after an RHEL 9 patch and reboot.
resolution: Generate an allow module with audit2allow. Verify /opt/dynatrace/gateway ownership survived the patch.

title: PKIX path building failed despite custom truststore
rootCause: An explicit javax.net.ssl.trustStore system property silently bypasses the Dynatrace custom truststore configuration, even with a correctly imported CA.
resolution: Remove the javax.net.ssl.trustStore override and restart. Confirm the log shows the custom certificate configuration being applied.

title: 500 - Cannot forward request (containerized ActiveGate)
rootCause: Known Apache HttpClient 5 forwarding bug (PRISM-5759) on the REST API module of a containerized ActiveGate.
resolution: Confirm a direct SaaS call works. Link PRISM-5759; raise an RFA if the symptoms are not an exact match.

title: HTTP client cannot be created behind a load balancer
rootCause: A load balancer terminating TLS presents its own certificate, SAN or ciphers that the client rejects.
resolution: Prefer an L4 passthrough load balancer. If terminating, the client must trust the LB certificate and the LB must re-encrypt to the ActiveGate.

title: Deprecated module blocked on Phase 3 tenant
rootCause: Phase 3 tenants block VMware, Azure, DB Insights, AWS, Memory Dump and Cloud Foundry modules.
resolution: Plan migration off the legacy modules before the Phase 3 rollout.

title: ActiveGate Unavailable on module save
rootCause: The error can surface from a different layer than the module logic, even when the module works.
resolution: Broaden the log scope beyond the module's own logs.

title: OutOfMemoryError in the ActiveGate JVM
rootCause: Heap exhausted. Either undersized for the workload or a leak in an extension or module.
resolution: Correlate the OOM timestamps with heap and CPU metrics, review recent extension or version changes, and capture a heap dump before raising -Xmx.
